executiveSummary: The client confirmed a Meta-only channel test, with Google Ads paused. Meta delivered seven attributed form lead events on $68.00 for September 1 to 7. The work also covered qualifying questions, campaign tagging, direct lead handoff and recovery of the native lead export for the earlier September 1 to 3 slice. The next measurement step is confirming which enquiries became appointments.

work.title: Client decision to pause Google Ads and run Meta alone
work.detail: Replying to the August report, the client asked to stop Google Ads and see how Meta performs on its own, explicitly to learn which channel works better for the store, with the option to switch back.
work.whyItMatters: Establishes the client’s chosen channel strategy for the next review.

work.title: Qualification and campaign tagging reviewed
work.detail: The team documented qualifying questions in the Meta lead form and campaign UTM parameters. These provide a basis for reviewing enquiry fit and source, but do not by themselves prove appointment quality.
work.whyItMatters: Supports a more useful assessment than form-event volume alone.

work.title: Lead handoff acknowledged by the client
work.detail: Recent Meta leads were emailed to the client, who replied that she would contact them that day. The acknowledgement verifies handoff and intended follow-up; completed contact and booking outcomes remain to be confirmed.
work.whyItMatters: Connects the campaign intake to the store’s follow-up process.

work.title: Early Meta audit prepared
work.detail: The September 1 to 3 audit recorded two attributed form lead events on $26.98. This early slice is retained as audit history; the newer September 1 to 7 result appears in the measured-results section.
work.whyItMatters: Keeps the early audit and the latest reporting window distinct.

work.title: Native lead export reconciled
work.detail: A verified export contained two distinct records for September 1 to 3 Eastern Time, one from Facebook and one from Instagram in the correct campaign and ad set. One matched the earlier screenshot handoff. Absence from a limited screenshot set does not prove a lead was never contacted.
work.whyItMatters: Provides a source record for follow-up reconciliation without exposing personal information.

decisions.decision: Google Ads paused at client request; Meta continues alone as a channel test.
Agreed to look at Google Business Profile management and low-effort website SEO as added value this month.

nextSteps.title: Confirm appointment outcomes
nextSteps.detail: Match the form enquiries to contact status, booked appointments and eventual sales.

nextSteps.title: Continue the agreed Meta test
nextSteps.detail: Review the independently dated Meta results and lead quality before the next channel decision.

nextSteps.title: Review local search improvements
nextSteps.detail: Confirm Google Business Profile upkeep and select useful website SEO improvements from the September discussion.

caveats: Meta form lead events are platform-attributed events, not verified bookings or sales.
Paused Google campaigns can retain activity from earlier in the selected dates.
The two-record native export covers September 1 to 3 only; it is not the seven-event September 1 to 7 total.
Google Ads includes September 8 only through the displayed collection time. The current day is partial and platform reporting is not real time.
